name: SEASONS: Winter
source:
It's the holiday season, when everyone enjoys time off to celebrate with family and friends. Unfortunately, you had no such luxury. No warm gatherings, no festive feasts.

But then, something unexpected happens, that wish you made as a little joke? It's been granted...

Who is this person inside your apartment?!? 

[From [url=https://melodymoonlight305.itch.io/seasonswinter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在是假期，每个人都享受与家人和朋友一起庆祝的时间。不幸的是，你没有这样的奢侈。没有热烈的聚会，没有喜庆的宴席。

但接下来，意想不到的事情发生了，你的愿望只是一个小玩笑吗？已经被授予了…

你公寓里的这个人是谁？！？

[来自[url=https://melodymoonlight305.itch.io/seasonswinter]itch.io[/url]]
